title: What is left to her?
question: V53 spends all the stocks Laura keeps on the bond ladder's reinvestment gap before it will lower the range she names in 2031, when nobody has heard a number yet. What is her flexibility where that pocket is empty, and should she keep a quarter back? (round 6 beat 6; the Genius Lab's seed; LR-10)
serves: North stars 3 and 4; Wharton: Client Knowledge (preserves appropriate financial flexibility; the reserve's size), Investment Strategy

rounds.name: Read alone: simulated Laura, co-sponsor and clearing house, judge with the case open
Reply by name and vote (the same three agents, continued)

essence: Our draft makes Laura spend every stock she keeps for herself before it will lower the range she announces in 2031, even though on that day nobody has heard a number yet; where that pocket runs dry, her flexibility is nothing until money comes back in 2042.

We tested keeping a quarter of those stocks back on that day and lowering the range instead: her pocket is empty by 2033 about 1 time in 15 instead of 1 in 5, the number she announces is delivered more often, the cheques are no worse, and it costs under $1,000 of the average gift.

So we offer one new sentence for the IPS, "set it aside from the stocks Laura keeps until only a quarter is left. Anything still missing lowers the whole range, before anyone hears it", plus two small fixes the case asks for.
decided: KILL 3-0 V53 P8's 'so her flexibility shrinks before her promise does' (Kai changed his mind in round 2: no promise exists on naming day, and the pitch's 'promise' is the cheques)
ADOPT 3-0 H25 as the P8 offer (0 words); KILL 3-0 H50

P7 'to attract co-sponsors' (+1, 3-0); P9 'the ladder and everything set aside for it become the operating reserve' (+6, 3-0 on the fix, 2-1 on the word); cut P5 'That is under a tenth of her money.' (-8, 2-1, Amara dissenting); V53 with all four 496 strict
The Lab's seed answered 3-0: where the pocket is empty her flexibility is nothing; the cushion back after 2042 is 'a refund, not a roof' (Final Report)
seeds: Why a quarter and not a fifth or a third? Untested between none and a quarter (Final Report: amount, reason, proof)
If the thread keeps 'under a tenth' (Amara's dissent), which whole idea pays for P9's six words?
changes: Offer in ../../ips_rewrite/inbox/2026-11-02_lauras-room.md; no draft changed by the room
